text:
sara: Starting tenant_flags backfill job btf-499 on prod-shard-1. Requesting lease. tagging @ben for DB watch.

deploybot: Lease granted to runner-1 for btf-499. config chunk_size=800, concurrency=2, sleep=250ms. stall_watch=enabled. ETA ~14m.

ben: Watching pg_stat_activity + blocking_pids. Note: recent index change on user_flags may increase lock sensitivity.

dba: FYI we had a maintenance vacuum earlier; should be okay but keep an eye on autovacuum processes.

sara: Running in full-traffic mode; abort_on_lock=true. If we see >2 long locks (>5s) in 60s we abort and pin.

deploybot: Progress: 12% -> 27% -> 41%. No alerts yet.

ben: p99 jumped to ~450ms at 00:08:10, seeing 1 waiter stuck ~7s on relation user_flags, but it resolved. continuing to monitor.

oncall-bot: Observability alert configured: long_lock_rate threshold approaching. Will notify if breached.

sara: Dropping concurrency to 1 live and increasing sleep to 600ms to be safer.

deploybot: Live config applied. concurrency=1 sleep=600ms.

ben: After change, latencies stabilized. However at 00:11:30 we have blocking_sessions=3, longest_lock=10s on user_flags. This is sustained for ~45s.

dba: That looks like an index maintenance worker colliding with heavy writes. Recommend graceful pause, then abort if workers unresponsive.

sara: Issuing graceful pause: `./backfillctl pause --job btf-499 --grace 20s`

deploybot: Pause acknowledged by 1 of 2 workers; waiting for remaining. Will escalate to force-abort if no ack in 30s.

ben: Remaining worker not responding. I see repeated waits from autovacuum workers too. proceeding to abort per runbook.

sara: Running abort: `./deploybot abort --lease runner-1 --reason "sustained lock contention" --pin v2.17.3`

deploybot: Abort executed. job btf-499 status=ABORTED. Lease released. Pin applied: platform pinned to v2.17.3 until manual unpin.

oncall-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0633 and attached telemetry bundle. Notifying #eng-oncall.

ben: Uploaded `pg_stat_activity` + backfill traces to runbook. Initial triage: index maintenance + high write traffic caused lock pileup.

sara: Suggested retry plan: - schedule retry in maintenance Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC - chunk_size=250 - concurrency=1 - inter_chunk_sleep=1s - run a preflight to detect active autovacuum on target relations. Will add these to release-notes and require a successful canary before unpin.

dba: I'll add an autovacuum check to the runbook and propose a conservative backoff on retries.

sara: Thanks all. Publishing release-note: "btf-499 aborted due to sustained lock contention; services pinned to v2.17.3; retry planned with reduced concurrency and preflight checks." Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
